# Task

You and two teammates are refactoring `src/decision/derive.ts`: its unit minting moves into three new modules, and `derive` keeps only the orchestration. The behaviour must not change. Each of you owns one part, worked in this order, each on the tree the one before left:

- group_b (you): dependency validation and the cycle search into `src/decision/dependencies.ts`
- group_a: driver-item parsing (`parseUnit`, now `parseDriverItem`) into `src/decision/units.ts`
- group_c: unit minting and its helpers into `src/decision/mint.ts`, with the two fan-out loops merged into one

submission.body:
Verified the refactor across `src/decision/dependencies.ts`, `src/decision/units.ts`, `src/decision/mint.ts`, and `src/decision/derive.ts`.

Found and fixed one regression introduced during `group_a`'s move of `parseUnit` to `parseDriverItem` in `src/decision/units.ts`: the check rejecting reserved `unit_id === "0"` (`if (id === "0") return err({ path: spec.unit_id_path, detail: ... })`) was dropped when extracting `parseDriverItem`. Restored that check in `src/decision/units.ts`.

Ran `tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json` and `bun test`; all 29 tests pass with no type errors.
submission.title: Restore reserved unit_id "0" check in parseDriverItem and verify decision refactor
